verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a Superhuman blog post titled 'how to use team comments' that describes letting teammates @mention each other and keep internal discussion hidden from external recipients. That points to a first-party team-comments feature, but the wording is a generic statement about 'the best email collaboration tools' rather than a concrete product description. The other team features (shared read statuses, reply indicators) are adjacent and earn no credit. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of comment threads attached beside a message, @mention notification behavior, plan availability, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-lead, we can discuss an email in an internal side-thread — comments and @mentions beside the message — instead of forwarding copies around

citations.quote: let you @mention teammates, share live email views, and coordinate responses without external recipients seeing internal discussions
